user.title: Connect to HelloFresh
user.description:
Choose how to connect your HelloFresh account:

- **Email and password (recommended)** — Home Assistant signs in for you and keeps the connection refreshed automatically.
- **Access token (advanced)** — paste a token from your browser session. Use this only if signing in with email and password does not work.

credentials.title: Connect to HelloFresh
credentials.description:
Sign in with your HelloFresh account email and password. Home Assistant uses them to log in and keep the connection refreshed automatically.

**Country** is the HelloFresh region your account belongs to (for example US, GB, AU). HelloFresh runs a separate site per country, so this selects the correct one to sign in to and read your plan, deliveries, and menu from.

token.title: Connect to HelloFresh
token.description:
Advanced backup option for when email and password sign-in is blocked. It works for up to ~60 days, until the token expires — then you'll be asked for a new one.

To get your `apiV2Auth` token:
1. In a desktop browser, sign in at your HelloFresh website ({site_example}) so you reach your account page.
2. Open the browser developer tools: right-click the page and choose **Inspect**, or press **F12** (Windows) / **⌥⌘I** (Mac).
3. Open the cookies view for your HelloFresh site:
   - **Chrome / Edge:** **Application** tab → in the left sidebar, expand **Cookies** → select your HelloFresh site.
   - **Firefox:** **Storage** tab → expand **Cookies** → select your HelloFresh site.
   - **Safari:** enable the Develop menu (Settings → Advanced → "Show features for web developers"), then **Storage** tab → **Cookies** → your HelloFresh site.
4. Find the cookie named **`apiV2Auth`** and copy its entire **Value**.
5. Paste it below. (A raw access token also works, but a full `apiV2Auth` value includes the refresh token for the longest-lasting connection.)

**Country** is the HelloFresh region your account belongs to (for example US, GB, AU) — pick the one matching the website you copied the token from.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to HelloFresh
reauth_confirm.description: Enter your HelloFresh account email and password to restore access.

reauth_token.title: Reconnect to HelloFresh
reauth_token.description:
Your HelloFresh token has expired. Paste a fresh `apiV2Auth` token to restore access.

To get it: sign in at your HelloFresh website and open developer tools (right-click → **Inspect**, or **F12**). Open the cookies view — **Chrome / Edge:** **Application** → **Cookies**; **Firefox:** **Storage** → **Cookies** — select your HelloFresh site, and copy the **Value** of the **`apiV2Auth`** cookie.

init.title: HelloFresh options
init.description: Adjust how often HelloFresh data is polled and how far back the cards can browse. These settings take effect right away — your credentials are not affected.

data_description.scan_interval_minutes: How often to poll HelloFresh for account and delivery data. Lower = fresher data and more requests; higher = lighter on the API. Range 5–1440 minutes; default 180 (3 hours). The login token is refreshed on its own schedule, so this does not affect sign-in.
data_description.history_weeks: How many weeks of past deliveries to load so you can browse them in the cards. Lower = less data fetched each refresh; raise it to look further back (use about 56 for a full year). Range 1–104 weeks; default 26 (about 6 months). Changing this reloads the integration.
data_description.menu_grace_weeks: How many weeks after its delivery date a week keeps its full browsable menu in the meal-planner card (your delivered meals stay highlighted); older weeks show only what shipped. Range 0–3 weeks; default 2 (the last couple of boxes stay browsable). 0 turns the grace window off. HelloFresh stops publishing the menu for older weeks, so weeks past what it still serves just fall back to delivered-only. Changing this reloads the integration.
data_description.enable_public_menu_fallback: If the signed-in menu data can't be loaded, scrape the public regional menu page so recipe names still appear. Leave on unless you only want authenticated data.
data_description.enable_favorites: Look up which meals are bookmarked in your HelloFresh cookbook on each refresh, so the meal-planner card can show a favorite heart. Costs one extra request per refresh: HelloFresh has no "list my favorites" endpoint, so the menu's recipes must be sent to a filter endpoint to learn which are favorites. Turn off to skip it — the add/remove favorite services keep working either way.
data_description.show_data_quality_issues: Raise warnings on the Repairs screen when HelloFresh data is degraded (menu fallback active, unrecognized payloads, account data unavailable, blocked write actions). Data keeps loading either way. Turn off to suppress these warnings and clear any that are already showing.

account_data_unavailable.title: HelloFresh account data is unavailable for {entry_title}
account_data_unavailable.description: HelloFresh could not load authenticated account data for **{entry_title}**. The integration is currently falling back to public menu data only. Refresh the integration, or reauthenticate with your HelloFresh email and password if sign-in has stopped working.

account_menu_fallback.title: HelloFresh menu fallback is active for {entry_title}
account_menu_fallback.description: HelloFresh could not load structured menu data for **{entry_title}** from authenticated API responses, so the integration is currently using the public menu page as a fallback. Delivery tracking may still work, but recipe details can be less complete until the API payload is recognized again. This clears on its own once authenticated menu data loads again; to silence it, use Ignore in this repair's menu, or turn off "Show data-quality repair warnings" in the integration's options.

payload_shape_changed.title: HelloFresh account payloads changed for {entry_title}
payload_shape_changed.description: HelloFresh returned authenticated data for **{entry_title}**, but the payload no longer matched the delivery shapes this integration knows how to parse. Diagnostics from this config entry will help confirm whether a regional API variation or a website change needs to be supported.

write_actions_unavailable.title: HelloFresh write actions are not verified for {entry_title}
write_actions_unavailable.description: You tried to use a HelloFresh action that changes account data for **{entry_title}**, such as selecting meals or skipping a week. The integration attempted the known best-effort write endpoints for your account, but none accepted the request, so the action was blocked instead of guessing further.
